name: ai-council
description: Multi-model AI council for coding, QA/QC, UI/UX, architecture, security, and product review using Gemini, Claude, Kimi, OpenRouter, Groq, OpenAI, and DeepSeek.

interface.shortDescription: Multi-model council for coding, quality, UI/UX, and product decisions
interface.longDescription: AI Council coordinates Gemini, Claude, Kimi, OpenRouter, Groq, OpenAI, and DeepSeek for substantial software and product tasks. It routes coding, QA/QC, UI/UX, architecture, security, and full-product work to specialist councils, gathers independent proposals from all available models, performs cross-review, skips unavailable providers automatically, and returns one consolidated implementation recommendation.
defaultPrompt: Review this coding task with all available AI Council models.
Run a QA/QC and regression review with the AI Council.
Review this UI/UX flow with all available AI Council models.
Review this feature across architecture, code, QA/QC, security, performance, and UI/UX.
